children: Independent biopharmaceutical company Specialised Therapeutics announced an
with Incyte Biosciences International, an affiliate of Incyte Corporation
, to register, commercialize, and distribute ruxolitinib cream (marketed as Opzelura in the U.S. and EU) across Australia.
Ruxolitinib 1.5% cream is a novel topical Janus kinase inhibitor approved in major markets for non-segmental vitiligo and mild to moderate atopic dermatitis.
The deal marks ST's initial expansion into the inflammatory dermatology market.
Under the expanded deal, Incyte will oversee the manufacturing and development of ruxolitinib cream, while ST handles Australian regulatory approvals, medical affairs, marketing, and distribution.

Incyte International Head Lee Heeson highlighted the strong operational alignment between the companies as ST prepares to file regulatory and reimbursement applications with Australian health authorities.

title: Specialised Therapeutics to commercialize Incyte’s Opzelura in Australia
